description: Eight channels faded in and out together on a trigger, with the fade times set in seconds and a pulse at the end of each fade

params.text: Fades all eight channels up by hand
Fades all eight channels down by hand
Switches the fades from straight lines to exponential curves
Sets how long a fade up takes, in seconds, shown on the display beside it
Sets how long a fade down takes, in seconds, shown on the display beside it

inputs.text: The signal into one of the eight channels
A trigger fades all eight channels up
A trigger fades all eight channels down
A trigger switches the exponential fades on and off
A voltage setting how long a fade up takes
A voltage setting how long a fade down takes

outputs.text: That channel's signal at the level the fader has reached
A copy of each trigger that starts a fade up, for starting another fader with it
A pulse once the fade up has finished
A copy of each trigger that starts a fade down, for starting another fader with it
A pulse once the fade down has finished

notes: crossfade mode treats channels 1, 3, 5 and 7 as one side and 2, 4, 6 and 8 as the other
in crossfade mode, with the fade down input 1 reaches output 1 and input 2 reaches output 2; with the fade up input 1 reaches output 2 and input 2 reaches output 1
a fade can be as short as 4ms.
